exposure: Low-dose aspirin (LDA) initiated between 12-16 weeks of gestation and discontinued at 28 weeks of gestation
cohort: Singleton pregnancies at high risk for preeclampsia, defined by factors such as a history of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, chronic hypertension, diabetes mellitus, autoimmune disease, obesity, and high normal blood pressure in the first trimester.
finding: Discontinuing low-dose aspirin (LDA) at 28 weeks of gestation did not significantly alter the incidence of preeclampsia, preterm preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction, preterm birth, maternal postpartum hemorrhage, or fetal malformations.
